Apartment Cleaning Cost – Here’s What You Need To Know Now

June 22, 2022
Table of Contents

One of the things that homeowners to-do- list when planning to move in or out of their apartment is to tidy it up. Many rental owners will require you to clean your space as a requisite when withdrawing your safety deposit. You can do it on your own or you can hire professional apartment cleaning contractors to do the work for you. You might start asking how much apartmentcleaning services cost.

Seeking professional help will be the best option for you to save time, money, and effort. Alongside this, hiring a professional will help you make sure that you and your loved ones are safe as they will be able to fully sanitize and disinfect the place.

This article will guide you to know more about apartment cleaning costs. Now, let’s talk about it.

Average Apartment Cleaning Prices

So far, the average rate for apartment cleaning is $200 per hour. However, when hiring a professional home cleaner most homeowners will spend around $200 to $500. The average cost depends on the area of the apartment or condo and whether you want it to be deeply cleaned.

Cleaning cost per square foot is frequently charged between 5 to 55 cents per square foot. Conventionally, homeowners are charged for about 90 that’s less than 1,000 square feet of space and $250 for 3,000 square feet or more. Discounts are usually offered for larger areas.

How much is the standard rate for apartment deep cleaning?

Before talking about how much the rate of a deep cleaning apartment costs, let’s take a look at the two circumstances where deep cleaning is recommended:

  • When you want to make sure that the new place you are moving in is hygienic and fresh.
  • When your apartment is in a filthy condition and you want it clean before moving out.

The running rate for an apartment deep cleaning costcan range between $110 to $170. However, this can go anywhere between $200 to $400 depending on the add-on services. Here are some of the things included for a deep cleaning service:

  • Furniture cleaning
  • Wiping fixtures, fans, and upholsteries
  • Emptying and sanitizing trash cans
  • Wiping down baseboards, blinds, door frames, countertops, and ceiling fans
  • Cleaning and disinfecting bathrooms, kitchens, and living room

Below are some of the price lists for apartment deep cleaning services:

  • 1-bed, 1-bath = $95-$130
  • 1-bed, 2-bath = $100-$165
  • 2-bed, 1-bath = $125-$180
  • 2-bed, 2-bath = $140-$200
  • 3-bed, 2-bath = $185-$285
  • 4-bed, 2-bath = $205-$400

This price range can differ for different contractors. You can message them for their prices or you can also message us online. At Shiny Carpet Cleaning, we can give you the best price for your apartment cleaning request

How about moving out apartment cleaning cost?

The estimated rate for moving out of apartment cleaning is between $100 to $355. Move out cleaning requires more work especially if the space hasn’t been deeply cleaned for a long time. The cost is going to be higher if the room size is larger as it requires more effort to sanitize and disinfect.

Most tenants would hire a professional with experience for their move out cleaning needs. It’s less hassle and more time for you to handle other important things for your relocation. Take note, there are different ways for a cleaning company to charge you for their apartment cleaning service. To secure your side, better ask them first about their rates and inclusions.

On the other hand, when you go for square foot cleaning, you can be charged up to 22 cents per square foot. Some companies give a discount for larger spaces. This is good for commercial spaces for rent. Landlords can take advantage of this one. It helps preserve the condition of the rental properties.

How much is carpet cleaning cost for apartments?

The industry’s average is $0.20 to $0.40 per square foot. The estimated carpet cleaning cost for 2 bedroom apartmentis $80 to $150. The kind of carpet cleaning method also matters for the price you’ll be paying. For instance, steam carpet cleaning is more expensive than dry carpet cleaning.

Many landlords require carpets to be cleaned before moving out of your apartment. This is beneficial for the next tenants and for the landlord since they save time and effort for cleaning.

You can also get carpet cleaning for your new house. This ensures no allergies and germs are present there before you move in. We only use eco-friendly carpet cleaners and deodorizers for the job. Regardless of what fabric your carpets are, we can safely wash and dry them.
